title: Rolex Catalog
description: Market-independent union of observed Rolex watch configurations across contributing markets, deduplicated by full modelReference. Historical configurations are retained.

sourceMarketCodes.description: Market codes whose collected data have been reconciled with this catalog; this does not assert complete market coverage or availability of every configuration in every market.

watchCount.description: Number of unique full modelReference values; must equal watches.length.

watches.$comment: JSON Schema uniqueItems rejects identical objects, not different objects sharing a modelReference. Validate modelReference uniqueness, watchCount equality, and modelReference = modelNumber + '-' + configurationCode separately.
